pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
The wall between traditional finance and crypto is crumbling. Yet the biggest bottleneck in asset management remains unchanged: ruthless market mechanics that force liquidations during sudden volatility. Creating liquidity without sacrificing core assets is where the real paradigm shift lives. 
​
Tokenizing equities (RWA) isn't just about moving traditional assets onto the blockchain. It’s about preserving ownership rights while providing operational flexibility. The infrastructure Verdex introduces directly targets this structural need.
​
The newly announced lending framework "https://useverdex.xyz/lend/termdelivers" a straightforward, practical solution:

🔹 Fixed rate
🔹 Fixed term 
🔹 No price oracle & zero liquidation risk before maturity
​
This architecture shields tokenized assets from forced panic selling, regardless of broader market turmoil. It establishes a insulated credit environment immune to short-term manipulation and flash crashes.
​
Looking ahead, RobinhoodChain is well-positioned to pioneer this tokenization cycle. Projects built on solid fundamentals and real-world utility will naturally capture significant market share from this expanding narrative.
​
Short-term market caps and daily volume are fleeting; well-engineered infrastructure is what remains. While noise dominates the background, those who evaluate the mechanics objectively continue to navigate the process with clarity. $VERDEX
